questions.question: GDB at add2 entry shows edi=40 esi=2 eax=40. Why is eax already 40?
options: First instruction movl already ran (break landed after it) or prior value; step to see 40->42
questions.explanation: Step with si: eax goes 40 then 42 — watch one insn at a time.
